text: One firm clean strike of a high-quality track-and-field lap bell. A crisp attention-getting metallic DING with a rich solid bronze body and a bright ringing tail. The sound of a real athletic bell signaling the end of a hard effort. One satisfying strike, immediate and clearly defined, ringing naturally into silence. Close dry recording. No crowds, no background, no repeated shaking, no clatter, no voice or music.
